# Workshop handoff rules

These rules belong to this fictional exercise. They do not represent CM incident policy.

Required information: severity, impact, incident start time, actions taken, current status and next owner. Use `Unknown` when the source omits a value. Keep facts separate from hypotheses and unresolved questions.

Describe impact in terms of a service and what its users cannot do. Do not invent affected-user counts. Retain timestamps exactly as supplied and flag a missing timezone.

Actions must include their observed outcome if the source supplies one. A restart alone does not establish recovery. State whether recovery has actually been confirmed.

The next owner should see both the next action and any uncertainty that could change it. If the source gives no owner, write `Unknown` rather than assigning someone.

Use the heading `Incident handoff` and end with `Workshop format: HANDOFF-V1`. This marker helps compare outputs in the exercise. It is not proof that Copilot loaded the skill.
